summary: Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed against public URL — templates (8, 5 IMCR + 3 Non-IMCR with sections/header/footer), products (150+ seeded, POST dedupes, DELETE soft-deletes), business-processes (36+ seeded, POST/DELETE), drafts (create with defaults, list with progress, get with embedded template, PUT persists values/validations/recipients, DELETE), render (subject + body), contingency lookup. Frontend: Templates tab (IMCR/Non-IMCR segments, cards), Drafts tab (list + delete), Library tab (segments, search, add product, import button present), navigation to Compose, section cards, Validate & Lock swaps to Edit, dropdowns render, Preview screen has recipients input, subject, body and Open in Outlook button — all functional individually. CRITICAL BUG: The 'timing' section (4th card) deterministically fails to lock when validating all sections in sequence, blocking the Send button (progress stays 6/7 even with 1.2s + 1.5s waits between clicks). This is not a test-timing issue — reproduces every run.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Validate & Lock on the 'timing' section (INVESTIGATING IMCR) does NOT lock it while every other section locks correctly. Progress stays at 6 of 7 validated so the 'Send via Email' button remains disabled and users cannot proceed to preview. Reproduces deterministically. Suspected root cause: useUpdateDraft.onSuccess invalidates ['draft', id] which refetches the draft after every save; the returned draft's `template.sections` array gets new object references between clicks, and combined with the Animated.View LinearTransition on the previously-locked card, the onPress handler bound to the 'timing' section fires with a stale/mismatched section reference so validateSection's `missing` check trips (or the setValidations update is dropped by a subsequent refetch merge). Fix idea: memoize sections from the first hydrated draft, or drop the refetch-on-save (rely on local state + trailing PUT), or use functional setValidations updater + setValues updater so state is never stale.

integration_issues.issue: Send button never enables because timing section fails to lock — full flow to preview is blocked from a fresh IMCR template. If timing is skipped it works.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings on web preview: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking, but should be tracked. Likely coming from a library (react-native-reanimated / bottom-sheet). Not a crash.

action_items: Fix the 'timing' section validation bug in /app/frontend/app/compose/[id].tsx — use functional state updaters (setValidations(prev => ({...prev, [key]: true}))) and consider disabling ['draft', id] invalidation on updateDraft.onSuccess (or removing the refetch) so section object references don't change mid-interaction. Verify user can lock all 7 IMCR sections in sequence and Send becomes enabled.
Optional: memoize `sections` from first hydration so identity is stable across saves.
critical_code_review_comments: useUpdateDraft.onSuccess invalidates both ['drafts'] and ['draft', id] — the latter causes useDraft to refetch after every keystroke/validate. This is expensive AND is the likely trigger for the timing-section lock bug. Consider skipping the ['draft', id] invalidation while the compose screen is mounted, or set staleTime to Infinity for that key.
compose/[id].tsx exceeds 400 lines — consider splitting SectionCard and useComposeState into their own modules.
validateSection and unlockSection close over `values`/`validations` from render scope; safer to use setValidations((prev)=>({...prev,[key]:val})) pattern to eliminate any stale-closure race.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks (FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers) — not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all screens/CRUD work; end-to-end send flow blocked by timing-section bug)

seed_data_creation: Backend already seeds 150 products, 36 business processes, contingency map, and 8 templates on startup. Tests create+cleanup TEST_-prefixed items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/ (pytest). The known open bug is the 'timing' section on an INVESTIGATING IMCR draft failing to lock via Validate & Lock — reproduce by tapping a first IMCR template card, then tapping every Validate & Lock button in order; timing (4th) stays unlocked and Send stays disabled. Once fixed, retest full flow: templates → compose → validate all 7 → Send via Email → Preview (subject/body/recipients/Open in Outlook).
rca_of_issue: Repro: navigate to Templates → tap first IMCR card (Major Incident – Investigating) → tap Validate & Lock on each section top-to-bottom. Expected: all 7 lock and Send button enables. Observed: sections 1,2,3,5,6,7 lock; 'timing' (index 4) does not — footer stays '6 of 7 validated'. Backend GET /api/drafts/{id} returns full default values for issue_started and next_update (both non-empty), so backend data is not at fault. Very likely a stale-closure / refetch-driven identity churn interacting with the LinearTransition layout animation on Animated.View. Mitigation: functional state updaters + suppress the ['draft', id] invalidation on save (or set staleTime infinite while composing). Once patched, all frontend flows should pass end-to-end.
